name: llmapicheck
description: LLM API Check — browser-only LLM capability & performance tester. Probe TTFT, throughput, prompt caching, reasoning, tool calling, structured output and vision support of any OpenAI-compatible model — no server, your API keys never leave your browser.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
